definitions.explanation: The act of stopping something undesirable from happening or spreading. Used for concrete measures and policies against problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{防止|ぼうし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧{防止|ぼうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}して→着用する：26849_chakuyousuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wear a mask to prevent infection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧{防止|ぼうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けた→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: New measures aimed at crime prevention were announced.

notes:
USAGE:
{防止|ぼうし} is almost always used as a compound modifier ({防止|ぼうし} + noun) or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. It sounds formal and is common in official contexts, signage, and policy language.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧{防止|ぼうし} (accident prevention)
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧{防止|ぼうし} (crime prevention)
- ⟦{再発|さいはつ}→再発：09017_saihatsu⟧{防止|ぼうし} (prevention of recurrence)
- ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧{防止|ぼうし} (infection prevention)
- {防止|ぼうし}⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧ (preventive measure)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {防止|ぼうし}: prevention (stopping something before it happens; formal, policy-oriented)
- ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧: prevention (proactive measures, especially medical; ⟦{予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}→予防接種：11068_yobousesshu⟧ = vaccination)
- ⟦{阻止|そし}→阻止：07633_soshi⟧: blocking, thwarting (stopping something already in motion)
